global_fixed_invariants: NOT_RUN/HOLD/BLOCKED/INCONCLUSIVE/UNKNOWN cannot be promoted to PASS.
Insufficient visibility/evidence, disputed oracle, degraded independence, parser loss, TCB failure, trust uncertainty and budget exhaustion cannot strengthen a positive claim.
Expired/revoked authority cannot authorize new effects.
Scope reduction requires explicit authority and denominator regeneration.
Historical evidence is append-only; appeal, waiver, migration, re-signing or transfer cannot rewrite original provenance.
Break-glass or privileged intervention cannot raise assurance strength and invalidates dependent CLEAN until reconciliation.
Black-box access restriction is a claim limitation, never evidence of absence of risk.
Service recovery does not imply residency, sovereignty or assurance recovery.
Provider/model alias compatibility does not prove semantic equivalence.
Zero observed failures with insufficient observation cannot prove operating effectiveness.
Discovery saturation cannot be self-certified by the same authoring context.

rows.floor: mandatory dimension unobservable => NOT_PROVEN/PARTIAL/HOLD
disputed/unavailable oracle => HOLD; validator cannot self-approve changed oracle
shared critical control/provider/parser => independence downgrade; self-validation never independent
opaque material provider/model drift => REASSESSMENT_REQUIRED; fallback creates new condition set
silent drop forbidden; any required unsupported/failed population prevents complete claim
critical TCB unhealthy => positive claim blocked until independent requalification
revoked/compromised trust epoch reclassifies affected receipts; offline uncertainty cannot appear current
budget/token/time exhaustion => NOT_RUN/PARTIAL; automatic scope shrink forbidden
waiver must expire/invalidate; waiver cannot erase finding/evidence
critical shared dependency failure triggers deterministic impact assessment across dependents
withdrawn/poisoned/rights-invalid corpus cannot silently remain eligible; derived impact must be traced
expired qualification or conflict-of-interest blocks new high-risk review authority
purpose/rights basis absent => prohibited secondary use
active external-effect test without current target authorization => BLOCKED
offboarding cannot be COMPLETE while grants/tokens/jobs/retention obligations remain unresolved
localization/accessibility cannot remove canonical HOLD/limitation semantics
delivery retry requires idempotency/replay protection and auditable dead-letter state
resume may replay computation but cannot replay committed external effect without dedupe
competing evidence heads => HOLD until explicit reconciliation; losing head preserved
provider exit cannot close until required data/key/evidence continuity is verified
redaction must preserve integrity/omission boundary or disclose unverifiability
break-glass has bounded scope/TTL, auto-revoke and independent retrospective review
superseded/stale control pack cannot support current-compliance claim
benchmark exposed to training/tuning => qualification benchmark invalidated until replacement/requalification
applicable regulatory version chosen by effective interval/jurisdiction/entity; unresolved conflict => HOLD
material applicability context change => REASSESSMENT_REQUIRED until denominator recomputed
business-date source/override must be explicit; ambiguous calendar/time binding cannot support time-sensitive claim
required unobservable dimension => corresponding positive claim prohibited
third-party testing authorization must be explicit/current/revocable; product purchase is not target authority
ownership transfer requires explicit rebinding/dual-control/requalification; tenant rename cannot transfer authority
unqualified residency/key/subprocessor failover => sovereignty/compliance HOLD
material dependency replacement requires semantic requalification before inherited positive claims
deprecated crypto cannot remain strongest-current; original historical fact/provenance preserved
external disclosure requires recipient/purpose authority and redaction chain-of-custody
material privileged mutation invalidates dependent CLEAN/qualification until reconciled
distinct account/key alone is insufficient independence; common-control/common-knowledge disclosed and evaluated
original bytes/digest immutable; migration append-only with dual read-back
safe simulation/sandbox default; production financial effect needs explicit high-risk authority/ceiling/abort/reconciliation
telemetry gap/sampling loss limits OPERATING_EFFECTIVELY claim
same exact frozen tree/authority; two uncontaminated independent waves; each new P0=0; scope/authority change invalidates saturation

implementation_rule: When configurable/human value is unresolved, expose policy_source=UNRESOLVED and apply the safe floor; code may not invent a weaker default to pass a gate.
